description: See one frame of the sequence your Premiere panel shares, at a given second. The panel exports the frame itself (nothing in the project changes) and the picture comes back here as an image plus its address in your library space. Takes a few seconds; the panel must be open and connected. First call premiere_list_connections to get the deviceId of your connected Premiere panel.

deviceId.description: The id of your connected Premiere panel, from premiere_list_connections.

seconds.description: The moment to look at, in seconds from the start of the sequence.

name: premiere_frame
title: See a Premiere Frame
